text: Bitcoin's 8.8% daily gain has lifted it near $70k, signaling renewed institutional confidence, while Ethereum's sharper 18.5% surge suggests traders are rotating toward altcoins and expecting higher volatility. The Fear & Greed index at 62 (Greed) with a 33-point weekly jump reflects fast-shifting sentiment from fear into risk-on territory, though Bitcoin dominance holding at 58.3% shows the move remains anchored to the largest asset rather than pure alt speculation. Volume at $127B is brisk but not extreme, indicating broad participation without the euphoria typical of parabolic rallies.
